"""Probe the base: sizes, hashes, supplementary tokens (scratch only)."""
import json
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-183-tests/tests/acceptance/W2-183")
import w2_183_support as s

base = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="probe-", dir="/tmp/w2-183-td"))
api = s.Api(base / "api")
small = s.build_project(base / "small" / "repo", s.small_files()); api.build(small.root, index=False)
big = s.build_project(base / "big" / "repo", s.big_files()); api.build(big.root, index=False)
ledger = s.build_project(base / "ledger" / "repo", s.ledger_files()); api.build(ledger.root, index=True)

out = {}
p = api.gov(small.root, s.SMALL_TICKET).packet
out["small_default"] = {"hash": p["hash"], "tokens": p["tokens"], "mand": s.mandatory_ids(p), "supp": s.supplementary_ids(p)}
p2 = api.gov(small.root, s.SMALL_TICKET).packet
out["small_repeat_same"] = p2["hash"] == p["hash"]

a = api.gov(big.root, s.BIG_TICKET)
out["big_default"] = a.envelope.get("error")
for b in (30000,):
    out["big_30000"] = {"tokens": a and api.gov(big.root, s.BIG_TICKET, "--budget", b).packet["tokens"]}

p = api.gov(ledger.root, s.LEDGER_TICKET).packet
out["ledger_default"] = {"hash": p["hash"], "tokens": p["tokens"], "mand_tokens": s.mandatory_tokens(p),
                         "supp_tokens": s.supplementary_tokens(p), "nsupp": len(p["supplementary"]),
                         "ids": s.supplementary_ids(p)[:3], "keys": sorted(p)}
m = s.mandatory_tokens(p)
for b in (60000, m + 3000, m + 6000, m + 9000, m + 5000):
    q = api.gov(ledger.root, s.LEDGER_TICKET, "--budget", b).packet
    out[f"ledger_b{b}"] = {"hash": q["hash"], "supp_tokens": s.supplementary_tokens(q), "n": len(q["supplementary"]),
                           "budget": q["budget"], "tokens": q["tokens"]}

for name, proj, tk in (("close_big_nofile", big, s.BIG_TICKET), ("close_small_nofile", small, s.SMALL_TICKET)):
    st = api.close_step(proj.root, tk)
    out[name] = st.out.get("error") or {"hash": st.out["value"]["hash"]}
with big.setting(65536):
    st = api.close_step(big.root, s.BIG_TICKET)
    out["close_big_65536"] = st.out.get("error") or {"hash": st.out["value"]["hash"], "budget": st.out["value"]["budget"]}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=repr))
print("workdir", base)

- **Child-process `PYTHONPATH`.** The support module now puts the parent's `PYTHONPATH` first and this tree's `src/` after it. That is how the planted breaks ran, and the normal run behaves as before.
- **Setting scope.** `Project.setting` writes `facts.yaml` untracked and the close step read it. The setting is not consulted by `gov context`, which stays at 6,000 whatever facts.yaml says. A test pins that.
